findings.title: Auth.init() call site contradicts its own DOMContentLoaded documentation
findings.summary: The design says init() is 'called once on DOMContentLoaded' but places the call bare at the bottom of the game.js IIFE (which runs synchronously at end of <body>). Self-contradictory; will confuse the implementation agent into wrapping the call incorrectly.

findings.title: Dockerfile.api missing build dependencies for better-sqlite3 native addon
findings.summary: node:20-alpine does not ship python3, make, or g++. npm ci will fail when node-gyp tries to compile better-sqlite3. Fix: add 'apk add --no-cache python3 make g++' before npm ci in the deps stage.

findings.title: renderLeaderboard() called by bare name inside game.js IIFE but is defined in auth.js — name not in scope
findings.location: Design § 'Changes to game.js' — injected snippet in finish()
findings.summary: The snippet calls bare renderLeaderboard(...) but that function lives in auth.js outside the IIFE. Must be window.Auth.renderLeaderboard(...). The function is also missing from the window.Auth return statement.

findings.title: mobile/auth.js copy never created — Dockerfile.mobile references a file that does not exist
findings.location: Design § 'Dockerfile updates' — Dockerfile.mobile; also Deployment Order (13 steps)
findings.summary: Dockerfile.mobile COPYs mobile/auth.js but that file does not exist in the repo and the deployment order never creates it. Docker build for mobile will fail.

findings.title: SQLite window function compatibility not confirmed (ROW_NUMBER() OVER)
findings.summary: ROW_NUMBER() requires SQLite ≥ 3.25.0. better-sqlite3 9.4.3 bundles 3.45.x so this is fine, but the design does not state this — add a one-line confirmation.

findings.title: Design does not explicitly confirm score/difficulty variable scope for the injected finish() hook
findings.summary: Both IIFEs do expose score and difficulty in finish() scope (verified). The design should state this explicitly to prevent the implementation agent from adding unnecessary global variables.

findings.title: JWT_SECRET missing-at-startup is not actually fatal — pod passes health probes without JWT_SECRET
findings.location: Design § Error Handling Matrix — 'JWT sign — Missing JWT_SECRET'
findings.summary: jwt.sign() throws at call time, not startup. The pod starts, passes /health probes, and only fails on first login. Fix: add an explicit startup guard in server.js that calls process.exit(1) if JWT_SECRET is unset.

findings.title: <dialog> / showModal() not supported on iOS < 15.4 — no fallback specified
findings.summary: The design uses native <dialog> without a compatibility statement or fallback. iOS 14 and iOS 15.0–15.3 will get a broken modal. Specify minimum browser targets or use a div-based overlay.

findings.title: Leaderboard button injection into .game-footer has unspecified layout impact
findings.summary: .game-footer uses justify-content:space-between with two children. A third injected button disrupts the layout. The design does not specify the required CSS change (e.g., a wrapper div for right-side buttons).

findings.title: bcryptjs.hashSync cost 12 blocks the event loop ~200–400 ms, risking liveness probe failures under concurrent registrations
findings.summary: Synchronous bcrypt at cost 12 on a single Node.js thread blocks the event loop. With periodSeconds:10 probes and no explicit failureThreshold, concurrent registrations can cause probe misses. Lower to cost 10 (NFR-1 minimum) or document the risk and add failureThreshold:3 to the probe spec.

findings.title: express 4.18.3 has a patched open-redirect CVE — use 4.19.2+
findings.summary: CVE-2024-29041 is fixed in Express 4.19.x. Pin to 4.19.2 or the latest 4.x patch.

findings.title: Auth.logout() exposed as clearSession() alias — does not update the UI
findings.summary: logout: clearSession clears localStorage but leaves the username in the header until page reload. Wrap it: function logout() { clearSession(); renderAuthHeader(); }

findings.title: Directory layout does not note that api-deployment.yaml contains the Service as a multi-doc YAML
findings.summary: The Service is embedded in api-deployment.yaml (---separated). Clarify in the directory layout comment.

findings.title: Leaderboard timestamp uses MIN(created_at) — shows first submission date, not date best score was set
findings.summary: MIN(created_at) shows when the user first played, not when they achieved their best score. Use MAX(created_at) or a correlated subquery, or document the choice explicitly.

findings.title: Auth.init() is not stated to be idempotent — could double-inject on unexpected re-call
findings.summary: Add a guard as the first line of init(): if (document.getElementById('auth-modal-root')) return;
